clue.text: I shouldn't worry about American appearing bizarre

indicators.note: to worry something about is to toss it around, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs off concern about an American who looks strange.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I shouldn't worry' reads as a reassuring phrase, but 'worry about' is the anagram signal: the letters of I SHOULDN'T plus A are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Something outlandish is strange and unfamiliar, the same as weird or bizarre.

clue.text: Regulate charge

explanation.surface: A short instruction to control a fee.
explanation.definitionFit: To put things in order is to regulate them; a charge is a command or instruction given to someone.

clue.text: Instrumentalist getting the bird

explanation.surface: A musician has been handed the bird, i.e. booed off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Getting the bird' suggests being jeered, but the bird is the definition: the trumpeter is a South American bird, and also a swan.
explanation.definitionFit: A trumpet player is an instrumentalist, and the trumpeter is also a kind of bird named for its call.

clue.text: Hot spot ? It's a promising situation

explanation.surface: A sunny holiday destination is described as offering good prospects.
explanation.definitionFit: A sunny place is a hot spot; idiomatically, a favourable position with good prospects is called a place in the sun.

clue.text: Tried moving round in the Northern US city

indicators.note: in places the round letter inside the rearranged letters
moving says the letters of the word tried shift into a new order

parts.note: a round shape looks like the letter O
in Northern English dialect 'the' is clipped to t', just the letter T

explanation.surface: Someone has tried relocating to a city in the northern United States.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' turns TRIED into DETRI; 'in' puts O (round) inside, giving DETROI. In Yorkshire and Lancashire speech 'the' is shortened to t', so 'the Northern' gives the final T.
explanation.definitionFit: Detroit, Michigan, is a major city in the United States famous for car making.

clue.text: Port stains initially washed out with water

indicators.note: initially means just the opening letter of the word stains is used

parts.note: washed out means pale, which is wan
the sea is a body of water

explanation.surface: Stains on harbour clothing come out once washed with water.
explanation.definitionFit: Swansea is a port city on the south coast of Wales.

clue.text: Impressive part of the picture

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A striking detail forms a section of a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: Something epic is grand and heroic in scale, so very impressive.

clue.text: Port stains initially washed out with water Standing out for United director

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held is 'Port stains initially washed out with water Standing out for United director': the 5-down clue is printed in front of the real one, so the clue is shown on two lights.
annotationWithheld.clue: Port stains initially washed out with water Standing out for United director

clue.text: Pale actor's make-up for Shakespearian role

indicators.note: make-up suggests the letters of pale actor are composed afresh in another order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A wan actor needs cosmetics to play a Shakespeare part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make-up' looks like theatrical cosmetics, but it signals that PALE ACTOR is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt, is the heroine of Shakespeare's Antony and Cleopatra.

clue.text: Multi-cultural guy?

parts.note: read 'multi-cultural' as versed in many fields of culture and learning rather than of mixed ethnic backgrounds

explanation.definitionFit: A Renaissance man has wide learning across many arts and sciences, so is cultured in many areas.

clue.text: Fold over tenor's old jacket

parts.note: to fold something over is to double it
T is the abbreviation for tenor in a choral score

explanation.surface: Someone folds a singer's antique coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A doublet is a close-fitting man's jacket worn in Tudor and Elizabethan times.

clue.text: Foreign name for single flowering plant

indicators.note: foreign suggests the word name is made strange, its letters rearranged

parts.note: single means one

explanation.surface: An exotic label for a solitary bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foreign' looks like a description of the name, but it is the anagram signal, and 'for' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The anemone, or windflower, is a garden plant grown for its bright flowers.

clue.text: Artist has ample but starts off being greedy

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a common crossword artist

indicators.note: starts off says the word's opening letter is removed

parts.note: ample means roomy, spacious

explanation.surface: A painter has plenty, yet sets out to be grasping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starts off' tells you to drop the opening letter of the synonym for 'ample'; 'has', 'but' and 'being' are only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapacious means grasping and avaricious, aggressively greedy.

clue.text: Make sense of total

explanation.surface: A two-part instruction: understand and then sum.
explanation.definitionFit: When a story adds up it is coherent and makes sense; to add up figures is to total them.

clue.text: Scored all at once

parts.note: read 'scored' as written in a musical score: the direction telling every performer to play together

explanation.definitionFit: Tutti is the musical instruction, Italian for 'all', marking a passage for the whole ensemble.

clue.text: Time to demand power for special unit

parts.note: to demand is to ask for
force is power or strength

explanation.surface: It is time to call for strength to form an elite squad.
explanation.definitionFit: A task force is a group assembled for a particular operation, a special unit.

clue.text: Team leader drove play bus

indicators.note: the leader of the word team is its first letter

parts.note: drove, as in ran a vehicle or business, gives ran
play, as in recreation, is sport

explanation.surface: A team captain drove the bus to the game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bus' is the definition: a bus is a form of transport.
explanation.definitionFit: A bus is a means of conveying people, an example of public transport.

clue.text: Exaggerate ruler's position

explanation.surface: A monarch's standing is overstated.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition reads the answer as two words: a ruler is placed over the state.
explanation.definitionFit: To overstate is to exaggerate; a ruler sits over the state, which is the ruler's position.

clue.text: Certainty of producing eight runs

indicators.note: producing suggests the letters of eight runs are worked into something new

explanation.surface: A batsman scoring eight runs is a dead cert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'producing' signals that EIGHT RUNS are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A sure thing is something guaranteed to happen, a certainty.

clue.text: Lethargy apparent in irate outburst

indicators.note: an outburst bursts the letters of in irate apart, rearranging them

explanation.surface: Sluggishness shows itself through an angry eruption.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outburst' is the anagram signal for IN IRATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Inertia is a tendency to do nothing or remain idle, i.e. lethargy.

clue.text: Dog fish

explanation.surface: A two-word list of animals: a hound and a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A growler is a dog that snarls; the growler is also a fish, the largemouth bass or a grunt.

clue.text: Range includes new bowl

indicators.note: includes says the second piece is held inside the first

parts.note: a range is a scope or area

explanation.surface: A cooking range comes with a new mixing bowl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bowl' is a stadium here, not a kitchen dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowl is an amphitheatre-shaped stadium, which is an arena.

clue.text: Flash of talent, say

indicators.note: say tells us the word for talent is heard, not spelt

parts.note: flair is a natural talent

explanation.surface: A flash of talent, for example.
explanation.definitionFit: A flare is a sudden burst of light, a flash.

clue.text: Opera bearing the name of an Irish saint

indicators.note: bearing means the first piece carries the second along with it

parts.note: Aida is Verdi's opera
N is the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: An opera titled after a saint from Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Aidan was an Irish monk who founded the monastery on Lindisfarne.

clue.text: Is including alternative chapter on ghostbusters

indicators.note: including says the other pieces go inside

parts.note: is, as in to be, means exists
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A reading list includes an extra chapter about ghost hunters.
explanation.walkthrough: The capitalised 'Is' looks like a link at the start, but it is a verb meaning 'is real', which then contains the other pieces; 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Exorcists drive out evil spirits, so are ghostbusters in a sense.

clue.text: Audibly entranced by bouquet

indicators.note: audibly says the synonym is heard, not spelt

parts.note: sent, as in 'it really sent me', means thrilled or entranced

explanation.surface: Someone is enchanted by a bunch of flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bouquet' is the aroma of wine, not a bunch of flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A bouquet is a fragrance, especially of wine, i.e. a scent.

clue.text: Concerned with a question of fieldwork

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to question is to doubt

explanation.surface: Someone is worried by a query about research done in the field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fieldwork' is a military earthwork, not research done outdoors.
explanation.definitionFit: A redoubt is a temporary fortification built in the field, a type of fieldwork.

clue.text: Number I prepared containing vitamin drink

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

indicators.note: containing says the vitamin letter goes inside

parts.note: prepared means made
E is a vitamin

explanation.surface: Someone made up a vitamin drink as a tonic.
explanation.definitionFit: Limeade is a soft drink of lime juice and sweetened water.

clue.text: Note Greek character is without mount

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so the Greek letter sits around the note

parts.note: eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet
N is the abbreviation for note, as in a footnote

explanation.surface: A remark that a Greek is missing his horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is taken as 'outside', not 'lacking', and 'mount' is a mountain, not a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Etna is the volcano on Sicily, and a mount is a mountain.

clue.text: Hear then if organisation is for German physicist

indicators.note: organisation says the letters of hear then if are arranged anew

explanation.surface: Listen, then, to how a German scientist is organised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organisation' is the anagram signal for HEAR THEN IF.
explanation.definitionFit: Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit was a German-born physicist who devised the temperature scale.
